accounting.fixed_fee_rule: Once on each valid depot-to-nondepot departure; one trip per vehicle
accounting.electricity_rule: Uniform energy-consumption accounting, including initial battery energy and final depot-return travel; no additional charge-session energy bill
accounting.note: A transparent capital-allocation plus traction-electricity objective, not a complete fleet TCO or measured Rivian lifetime. The 10-year, 250-day, zero-residual assumptions are configurable.

electricity_price.description: Previously discussed frozen 2025 US commercial electricity price, 13.41 cents/kWh

vehicle_price.description: Rivian Commercial Van Delivery 700 reference purchase price; exclude taxes and incentives

economic_assumptions.description: Delivery-fleet TCO example uses a 10-year vehicle lifetime and 250 operating days/year; zero residual is our explicit simplification

consumption.description: Frozen benchmark Rivian reference: 100 kWh / 257 km, linear distance-consumption model
